scope: Declared S-DSP core only, not SPC700/ROM/device. Six16384frame stereo loads. Every fullPCM/266semantic state/queue2/fullARAM checked outside timing. Dense8kHz2events includes reg/ownedRAM byte enqueue and compaction checks; no pending entries moved. Wall primary may jump, CPUTIME reference may be quantized and2 calls included in wall. Linux is WSL2.
